fixture.text: indexed user messages, 350 repetitions of review history per message

method: Actual registered hooks; 10 warmups and 100 samples; independent JSON-parsed bodies prepared outside timing; signature-only measures the production bounded scanner directly. No nonce scan, HTTP, DB, or stringify in timed dispatch. stringify is a separate baseline.
gate: 106 pass, 5 opt-in skips, 0 fail, 421 assertions, 111 tests across 15 files
limits: 100000 inspected nodes, 128 levels, 32 Mi UTF-16 string/key units; signature scan 8 message entries x 32 text blocks x 4096-character prefixes
limitations: One final run under parallel load; tails include JSC warmup/GC/runner variation, not a wall-clock guarantee. No RSS measurement. The signature is a managed-prefix witness, not full first-body cryptographic provenance.
